createResumeHandoff.name: createResumeHandoff
createResumeHandoff.title: Send approved resume to Infinite Resume
createResumeHandoff.description: Creates a one-time editable preview of a complete resume in Infinite Resume. Stores the submitted content until the link is opened or expires, and returns the preview link, valid for 45 minutes. Requires metadata.userConfirmed to be true, which records that the user approved this exact content for transfer.

refreshResumeHandoff.name: refreshResumeHandoff
refreshResumeHandoff.title: Replace approved Infinite Resume preview
refreshResumeHandoff.description: Replaces this connected account's unclaimed, unexpired preview with a new complete resume. Revokes the previous preview link in the same operation and returns a new link, valid for 45 minutes. Fails if the previous preview was already opened, expired, revoked, or created by another account.

previousHandoffId.description: The unclaimed, unexpired handoff ID created by this connected account. The old preview link will be revoked.
